recommendations.title: Underutilized EC2 instances detected
recommendations.description: 3 EC2 instances have average CPU utilization below 5% over the past 30 days.
recommendations.recommended_action: Downsize to t3.small or consider Spot instances for non-critical workloads.

recommendations.title: Unattached EBS volumes
recommendations.description: 2 EBS volumes are not attached to any instance.
recommendations.current_state: vol-0aaa111 (100GB gp3), vol-0bbb222 (50GB gp2) unattached for 45+ days
recommendations.recommended_action: Snapshot and delete unattached volumes, or reattach if needed.

recommendations.title: Security group allows SSH from 0.0.0.0/0
recommendations.description: sg-0abc123 allows inbound SSH (port 22) from any IP address.
recommendations.current_state: sg-0abc123 has ingress rule: TCP/22 from 0.0.0.0/0
recommendations.recommended_action: Restrict SSH access to known CIDR ranges or use SSM Session Manager.
recommendations.cfn_fix:
SecurityGroupIngress:
  - IpProtocol: tcp
    FromPort: 22
    ToPort: 22
    CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/8

recommendations.title: S3 bucket without encryption
recommendations.description: Bucket data-exports-staging has no default encryption configured.
recommendations.recommended_action: Enable SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS default encryption.

recommendations.title: RDS instance without Multi-AZ
recommendations.description: Production database myapp-db is running single-AZ.
recommendations.recommended_action: Enable Multi-AZ for automatic failover and improved availability.

recommendations.title: Lambda function with excessive memory allocation
recommendations.description: Function process-events is allocated 1024MB but peaks at 180MB.
recommendations.recommended_action: Reduce memory to 256MB. Use Lambda Power Tuning to find optimal setting.
